objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-default-rdp-file-deletion
objects.description: This detection identifies the deletion of the Default.rdp file from a user’s Documents folder. This file is automatically created or updated by the Remote Desktop Connection client (mstsc.exe) whenever a user initiates an RDP session. It contains session configuration data, such as the remote hostname and display settings.
